# Workbench 1.8.11
# project: sidecar
# run: executed
# lineage_hash: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
# Coverage
# completed | model.ols | snapshot | FPC is supplied, but the frozen Workbench linearization engine does not apply FPC; native FPC would change the executed covariance. Workbench completed this step; numeric values come from a verified result sidecar, without native re-estimation.
# post | postestimation.wald | snapshot | Dependent post-estimation needs its own completed Workbench result sidecar; no fitted state is reconstructed. Workbench completed this step; numeric values come from a verified result sidecar, without native re-estimation.

data <- list()
results <- list()
checks <- list()
args <- commandArgs(FALSE)
script <- sub("^--file=", "", args[grepl("^--file=", args)])
base <- dirname(normalizePath(script))
wb_read <- function(name, digest, fmt, options=list()) {
  path <- file.path(base, name)
  hash <- system2("shasum", c("-a", "256", shQuote(path)), stdout=TRUE)
  if (length(hash) != 1L || substr(hash,1,64) != digest) stop(paste("SHA256 mismatch:", name))
  switch(fmt,
    csv=do.call(read.csv, c(list(file=path, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, blank.lines.skip=FALSE, na.strings=c("", "NA")), options)),
    dta=haven::read_dta(path), sav=haven::read_sav(path), xlsx=openxlsx::read.xlsx(path, sheet=if(is.null(options$sheet)) 1 else options$sheet, check.names=FALSE, skipEmptyRows=FALSE, skipEmptyCols=FALSE),
    parquet=as.data.frame(arrow::read_parquet(path)), stop("Unsupported source format"))
}
wb_check <- function(actual, expected, absolute, relative, label) {
  if (length(actual)!=1 || !is.finite(actual) || abs(actual-expected)>absolute+relative*abs(expected))
    stop(paste(label, actual, "!=", expected))
}

data[["source"]] <- wb_read("data.csv", "5f8d0cc66fc9efdfd08e6a06640ea410d58671fe93ac5cac2ad90d6aa68de937", "csv", list("sep"=",", "fileEncoding"="UTF-8", "header"=TRUE))
# Workbench completed this step: Sampling OLS completed in Workbench
data[["completed"]] <- wb_read("completed.csv", "5f8d0cc66fc9efdfd08e6a06640ea410d58671fe93ac5cac2ad90d6aa68de937", "csv", list("sep"=",", "fileEncoding"="UTF-8", "header"=TRUE))
checks[[1]] <- as.numeric(nrow(data[["completed"]]))
stopifnot(identical(names(data[["completed"]]), c("stratum", "psu", "y", "x1", "x2", "weight", "fpc", "subpop")))
wb_result_bridge <- tempfile(fileext=".py")
writeLines("import base64\nimport json\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport sys\nfrom workbench.contracts.common.envelope import thaw_json\nfrom workbench.script_export.result_snapshot import ResultSnapshotRef, read_result_snapshot\n\nconfiguration = json.loads(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[2]))\nreference = ResultSnapshotRef(**configuration['reference'])\nvalues = read_result_snapshot(Path(sys.argv[1]), reference, expected_binding=configuration['binding'])\nfor name, distribution in configuration['distributions'].items():\n    if values['statistics'][name]['distribution'] != distribution:\n        raise AssertionError('Result sidecar reference distribution differs')\nif sys.argv[3] == 'r':\n    print(json.dumps(thaw_json(values), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))\nelif sys.argv[3] == 'stata':\n    lines = []\n    for index, path in enumerate(configuration['queries']):\n        value = values\n        for key in path:\n            value = value[key]\n        if value is not None and type(value) not in (int, float):\n            raise AssertionError('Result sidecar query is not numeric')\n        token = '.' if value is None else repr(value)\n        lines.append('scalar wb_result_' + str(configuration['index']) + '_' + str(index) + ' = ' + token)\n    lines.append('scalar wb_result_valid_' + str(configuration['index']) + ' = 1')\n    fd = os.open(sys.argv[4], os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)\n    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:\n        handle.write('\\n'.join(lines) + '\\n')\nelse:\n    raise AssertionError('Unsupported result bridge mode')\n",wb_result_bridge,useBytes=TRUE)
wb_result_json <- system2("python3",c(shQuote(wb_result_bridge),shQuote(base),"","r"),stdout=TRUE,stderr=TRUE)
if (!is.null(attr(wb_result_json,"status")) && attr(wb_result_json,"status")!=0) stop(paste(wb_result_json,collapse="\n"))
wb_result_values1 <- jsonlite::fromJSON(paste(wb_result_json,collapse="\n"),simplifyVector=FALSE)

checks[[7]] <- as.numeric(wb_result_values1[["std_errors"]][["x1"]])

wb_model <- function(fit, covariance=vcov(fit), df=NULL, distribution="z", aliases=NULL, likelihood=TRUE) {
  beta <- coef(fit)
  names <- names(beta)
  if (!is.null(aliases)) names <- vapply(names, function(n) if (n %in% names(aliases)) aliases[[n]] else n, character(1))
  names <- gsub("`", "", names, fixed=TRUE)
  names[names=="(Intercept)"] <- "Intercept"
  names(beta) <- names
  se <- sqrt(diag(covariance)); names(se) <- names
  statistic <- beta/se
  p <- if (distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(statistic),df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(statistic))
  list(beta=beta,se=se,statistic=statistic,p=p,covariance=covariance,names=names,df=df,
       distribution=distribution,nobs=nobs(fit),fit=fit,loglik=if(likelihood) as.numeric(logLik(fit)) else NULL,link=if(is.null(fit$family$link)) "identity" else fit$family$link, design=model.matrix(fit),sample=rownames(model.frame(fit)))
}

wb_model_frame4 <- data[["selected"]]

wb_frame <- wb_model_frame4
wb_fit <- lm(`y` ~ `x1` + `x2`, data=wb_frame)
wb_cov <- vcov(wb_fit)

wb_model <- function(fit, covariance=vcov(fit), df=NULL, distribution="z", aliases=NULL, likelihood=TRUE) {
  beta <- coef(fit)
  names <- names(beta)
  if (!is.null(aliases)) names <- vapply(names, function(n) if (n %in% names(aliases)) aliases[[n]] else n, character(1))
  names <- gsub("`", "", names, fixed=TRUE)
  names[names=="(Intercept)"] <- "Intercept"
  names(beta) <- names
  se <- sqrt(diag(covariance)); names(se) <- names
  statistic <- beta/se
  p <- if (distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(statistic),df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(statistic))
  list(beta=beta,se=se,statistic=statistic,p=p,covariance=covariance,names=names,df=df,

}

wb_single <- function(model, estimate, se) {
  value <- estimate/se
  p <- if (model$distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(value),model$df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(value))
  list(value=value,p_value=p,df=model$df,df_denominator=NULL,distribution=model$distribution)
}
wb_wald <- function(model, R, target) {
  gap <- R %*% model$beta-target
  if (qr(R)$rank!=nrow(R)) stop("Dependent Wald restrictions")
  W <- as.numeric(t(gap) %*% solve(R %*% model$covariance %*% t(R),gap));q <- nrow(R)
  finite <- model$distribution=="t"; value <- if(finite) W/q else W
  denominator <- if(finite) model$df else NULL
  if(finite && identical(model$df_method,"design") && q>1) {
    denominator <- model$df-q+1
    if(denominator<=0) stop("Too few survey design degrees of freedom")
    value <- W*denominator/(model$df*q)
  }
  p <- if(finite) pf(value,q,denominator,lower.tail=FALSE) else pchisq(value,q,lower.tail=FALSE)
  list(beta=list(),se=list(),statistics=list(test=list(value=value,p_value=p,df=q,df_denominator=denominator,distribution=if(finite) "F" else "chi2")))
}
wb_lincom <- function(model, vector, constant) {
  estimate <- sum(vector*model$beta)+constant
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(vector) %*% model$covariance %*% vector))
  list(beta=list(estimate=estimate),se=list(estimate=se),statistics=list(test=wb_single(model,estimate,se)))
}
wb_nlcom <- function(model, fn) {
  point <- model$beta;estimate <- fn(point)
  gradient <- vapply(seq_along(point),function(i) { h <- 6e-6*max(1,abs(point[i]));hi <- lo <- point;hi[i] <- hi[i]+h;lo[i] <- lo[i]-h;(fn(hi)-fn(lo))/(2*h) }, numeric(1))
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(gradient) %*% model$covariance %*% gradient))
  list(beta=list(estimate=estimate),se=list(estimate=se),statistics=list(test=wb_single(model,estimate,se)))
}
wb_lr <- function(full,restricted) {
  if (is.null(full$loglik)||is.null(restricted$loglik)) stop("Likelihood unavailable")
  if (!identical(full$sample,restricted$sample)) stop("LR estimation samples differ")
  if (!all(restricted$names %in% full$names)||length(full$names)<=length(restricted$names)) stop("Models are not nested")
  value <- max(0,2*(full$loglik-restricted$loglik));df <- length(full$beta)-length(restricted$beta)
  list(beta=list(),se=list(),statistics=list(test=list(value=value,p_value=pchisq(value,df,lower.tail=FALSE),df=df,df_denominator=NULL,distribution="chi2")))
}
wb_links <- list(identity=function(eta) list(rep(1,length(eta)),rep(0,length(eta))),
  logit=function(eta) {p <- plogis(eta);list(p*(1-p),p*(1-p)*(1-2*p))},
  probit=function(eta) list(dnorm(eta),-eta*dnorm(eta)),log=function(eta) list(exp(eta),exp(eta)))
wb_margins <- function(model,variables,at) {
  X <- model$design;if (at=="means") X <- matrix(colMeans(X),nrow=1)
  beta <- model$beta;derivatives <- wb_links[[model$link]](as.numeric(X %*% beta))
  mean_first <- mean(derivatives[[1]]);curvature <- colMeans(derivatives[[2]]*X)
  estimates <- errors <- statistics <- list()
  for (name in variables) {
    j <- match(name,model$names);estimate <- mean_first*beta[j];gradient <- curvature*beta[j];gradient[j] <- gradient[j]+mean_first
    se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(gradient) %*% model$covariance %*% gradient))
    estimates[[name]] <- estimate;errors[[name]] <- se;statistics[[name]] <- wb_single(model,estimate,se)
  }
  list(beta=estimates,se=errors,statistics=statistics,nobs=model$nobs)
}

wb_model <- function(fit, covariance=vcov(fit), df=NULL, distribution="z", aliases=NULL, likelihood=TRUE) {
  beta <- coef(fit)
  names <- names(beta)
  if (!is.null(aliases)) names <- vapply(names, function(n) if (n %in% names(aliases)) aliases[[n]] else n, character(1))
  names <- gsub("`", "", names, fixed=TRUE)
  names[names=="(Intercept)"] <- "Intercept"
  names(beta) <- names
  se <- sqrt(diag(covariance)); names(se) <- names
  statistic <- beta/se
  p <- if (distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(statistic),df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(statistic))
  list(beta=beta,se=se,statistic=statistic,p=p,covariance=covariance,names=names,df=df,
       distribution=distribution,nobs=nobs(fit),fit=fit,loglik=if(likelihood) as.numeric(logLik(fit)) else NULL,link=if(is.null(fit$family$link)) "identity" else fit$family$link, design=model.matrix(fit),sample=rownames(model.frame(fit)))
}

import hashlib

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def wb_read(name, digest, fmt, options=None):
    path = base / name
    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
        raise AssertionError('SHA256 mismatch: ' + name)
    readers = {'csv': pd.read_csv, 'dta': pd.read_stata, 'sav': pd.read_spss,
               'xlsx': pd.read_excel, 'parquet': pd.read_parquet}
    return readers[fmt](path, **(options or {}))

def wb_check(actual, expected, absolute, relative, label):
    if not math.isfinite(float(actual)) or abs(actual-expected) > absolute + relative*abs(expected):
        raise AssertionError(f'{label}: {actual!r} != {expected!r}')

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from scipy import stats

def wb_public(name):
    if name.startswith("Q('") and name.endswith("')"):
        return name[3:-2]
    return name

def wb_model(fit, names=None, df=None, distribution=None, link="identity"):
    names = names or list(fit.model.exog_names)
    beta = np.asarray(fit.params)
    covariance = np.asarray(fit.cov_params())
    names = [wb_public(str(n)) for n in names]
    df = getattr(fit, 'df_resid_inference', fit.df_resid) if df is None else df
    distribution = distribution or ('t' if getattr(fit, 'use_t',False) else 'z')
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(covariance))
    statistic = beta/se
    p = 2*(stats.t.sf(np.abs(statistic),df) if distribution=='t' else stats.norm.sf(np.abs(statistic)))
    return dict(beta=dict(zip(names,beta)), se=dict(zip(names,se)), statistic=dict(zip(names,statistic)),
                p=dict(zip(names,p)), covariance=covariance, names=names, df=df if distribution=='t' else None,
                distribution=distribution, nobs=float(fit.nobs), fit=fit, loglik=getattr(fit,'llf',None), link=link, design=fit.model.exog, sample=list(fit.model.data.row_labels))

wb_frame = data['selected'].copy()

def wb_single(model, estimate, se):
    statistic = estimate/se
    distribution = model['distribution']
    df = model['df']
    p = 2*(stats.t.sf(abs(statistic),df) if distribution=='t' else stats.norm.sf(abs(statistic)))
    return dict(value=statistic, p_value=p, df=df, df_denominator=None, distribution=distribution)

def wb_wald(model, constraints):
    names=model['names']
    if any(not set(item['terms'])<=set(names) for item in constraints):raise AssertionError('Unknown Wald coefficient')
    R=np.asarray([[item['terms'].get(n,0) for n in names] for item in constraints],dtype=float)
    target=np.asarray([item.get('value',0) for item in constraints],dtype=float)
    if np.linalg.matrix_rank(R)!=len(constraints): raise AssertionError('Dependent Wald restrictions')
    beta=np.asarray([model['beta'][n] for n in names])
    gap=R@beta-target
    W=float(gap@np.linalg.solve(R@model['covariance']@R.T,gap))
    q=len(constraints)
    finite=model['distribution']=='t'
    value=W/q if finite else W
    denominator=model['df'] if finite else None
    if finite and model.get('df_method')=='design' and q>1:
        denominator=model['df']-q+1
        if denominator<=0:raise AssertionError('Too few survey design degrees of freedom')
        value=W*denominator/(model['df']*q)
    p=stats.f.sf(value,q,denominator) if finite else stats.chi2.sf(value,q)
    return dict(beta={},se={},statistics={'test':dict(value=value,p_value=p,df=q,df_denominator=denominator,distribution='F' if finite else 'chi2')})

def wb_lincom(model, terms, constant):
    vector=np.asarray([terms.get(n,0) for n in model['names']],dtype=float)
    if not set(terms)<=set(model['names']):raise AssertionError('Unknown lincom coefficient')
    estimate=float(vector@np.asarray(list(model['beta'].values()))+constant)
    se=float(np.sqrt(vector@model['covariance']@vector))
    return dict(beta={'estimate':estimate},se={'estimate':se},statistics={'test':wb_single(model,estimate,se)})

def wb_nlcom(model, function):
    point=dict(model['beta']);names=model['names'];estimate=float(function(point));gradient=[]
    for name in names:
        h=6e-6*max(1,abs(point[name]))
        gradient.append((function({**point,name:point[name]+h})-function({**point,name:point[name]-h}))/(2*h))
    gradient=np.asarray(gradient)
    se=float(np.sqrt(gradient@model['covariance']@gradient))
    return dict(beta={'estimate':estimate},se={'estimate':se},statistics={'test':wb_single(model,estimate,se)})

def wb_lr(full,restricted):
    if full['loglik'] is None or restricted['loglik'] is None:raise AssertionError('Likelihood is unavailable')
    if full['sample']!=restricted['sample']:raise AssertionError('LR estimation samples differ')
    if not set(restricted['names'])<set(full['names']):raise AssertionError('Models are not nested')
    value=max(0,2*(full['loglik']-restricted['loglik']));df=len(full['names'])-len(restricted['names'])
    return dict(beta={},se={},statistics={'test':dict(value=value,p_value=stats.chi2.sf(value,df),df=df,df_denominator=None,distribution='chi2')})

}

def wb_margins(model, variables, at):
    X=model['design']

  beta <- coef(fit)

  if (!is.null(aliases)) names <- vapply(names, function(n) if (n %in% names(aliases)) aliases[[n]] else n, character(1))
  names <- gsub("`", "", names, fixed=TRUE)
  names[names=="(Intercept)"] <- "Intercept"
  names(beta) <- names
  se <- sqrt(diag(covariance)); names(se) <- names
  statistic <- beta/se
  p <- if (distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(statistic),df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(statistic))
  list(beta=beta,se=se,statistic=statistic,p=p,covariance=covariance,names=names,df=df,

}

    path = base / name

        raise AssertionError('SHA256 mismatch: ' + name)
    readers = {'csv': pd.read_csv, 'dta': pd.read_stata, 'sav': pd.read_spss,

    return readers[fmt](path, **(options or {}))

        raise AssertionError(f'{label}: {actual!r} != {expected!r}')

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from scipy import stats

def wb_public(name):
    if name.startswith("Q('") and name.endswith("')"):
        return name[3:-2]
    return name

def wb_model(fit, names=None, df=None, distribution=None, link="identity"):
    names = names or list(fit.model.exog_names)

wb_model <- function(fit, covariance=vcov(fit), df=NULL, distribution="z", aliases=NULL, likelihood=TRUE) {
  beta <- coef(fit)
  names <- names(beta)
  if (!is.null(aliases)) names <- vapply(names, function(n) if (n %in% names(aliases)) aliases[[n]] else n, character(1))
  names <- gsub("`", "", names, fixed=TRUE)
  names[names=="(Intercept)"] <- "Intercept"
  names(beta) <- names
  se <- sqrt(diag(covariance)); names(se) <- names
  statistic <- beta/se
  p <- if (distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(statistic),df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(statistic))
  list(beta=beta,se=se,statistic=statistic,p=p,covariance=covariance,names=names,df=df,
       distribution=distribution,nobs=nobs(fit),fit=fit,loglik=if(likelihood) as.numeric(logLik(fit)) else NULL,link=if(is.null(fit$family$link)) "identity" else fit$family$link, design=model.matrix(fit),sample=rownames(model.frame(fit)))
}

import hashlib

import numpy as np

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def wb_read(name, digest, fmt, options=None):
    path = base / name
    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
        raise AssertionError('SHA256 mismatch: ' + name)
    readers = {'csv': pd.read_csv, 'dta': pd.read_stata, 'sav': pd.read_spss,
               'xlsx': pd.read_excel, 'parquet': pd.read_parquet}
    return readers[fmt](path, **(options or {}))

def wb_check(actual, expected, absolute, relative, label):
    if not math.isfinite(float(actual)) or abs(actual-expected) > absolute + relative*abs(expected):
        raise AssertionError(f'{label}: {actual!r} != {expected!r}')

data['source'] = wb_read('data.csv', '5f8d0cc66fc9efdfd08e6a06640ea410d58671fe93ac5cac2ad90d6aa68de937', 'csv', {'sep': ',', 'encoding': 'utf-8', 'header': 0})

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from scipy import stats

def wb_public(name):
    if name.startswith("Q('") and name.endswith("')"):
        return name[3:-2]
    return name

def wb_model(fit, names=None, df=None, distribution=None, link="identity"):
    names = names or list(fit.model.exog_names)
    beta = np.asarray(fit.params)
    covariance = np.asarray(fit.cov_params())
    names = [wb_public(str(n)) for n in names]
    df = getattr(fit, 'df_resid_inference', fit.df_resid) if df is None else df
    distribution = distribution or ('t' if getattr(fit, 'use_t',False) else 'z')
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(covariance))
    statistic = beta/se
    p = 2*(stats.t.sf(np.abs(statistic),df) if distribution=='t' else stats.norm.sf(np.abs(statistic)))
    return dict(beta=dict(zip(names,beta)), se=dict(zip(names,se)), statistic=dict(zip(names,statistic)),
                p=dict(zip(names,p)), covariance=covariance, names=names, df=df if distribution=='t' else None,
                distribution=distribution, nobs=float(fit.nobs), fit=fit, loglik=getattr(fit,'llf',None), link=link, design=fit.model.exog, sample=list(fit.model.data.row_labels))

wb_model <- function(fit, covariance=vcov(fit), df=NULL, distribution="z", aliases=NULL, likelihood=TRUE) {
  beta <- coef(fit)
  names <- names(beta)
  if (!is.null(aliases)) names <- vapply(names, function(n) if (n %in% names(aliases)) aliases[[n]] else n, character(1))
  names <- gsub("`", "", names, fixed=TRUE)
  names[names=="(Intercept)"] <- "Intercept"
  names(beta) <- names
  se <- sqrt(diag(covariance)); names(se) <- names
  statistic <- beta/se
  p <- if (distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(statistic),df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(statistic))
  list(beta=beta,se=se,statistic=statistic,p=p,covariance=covariance,names=names,df=df,
       distribution=distribution,nobs=nobs(fit),fit=fit,loglik=if(likelihood) as.numeric(logLik(fit)) else NULL,link=if(is.null(fit$family$link)) "identity" else fit$family$link, design=model.matrix(fit),sample=rownames(model.frame(fit)))
}

import hashlib

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def wb_read(name, digest, fmt, options=None):
    path = base / name
    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
        raise AssertionError('SHA256 mismatch: ' + name)
    readers = {'csv': pd.read_csv, 'dta': pd.read_stata, 'sav': pd.read_spss,
               'xlsx': pd.read_excel, 'parquet': pd.read_parquet}
    return readers[fmt](path, **(options or {}))

def wb_check(actual, expected, absolute, relative, label):
    if not math.isfinite(float(actual)) or abs(actual-expected) > absolute + relative*abs(expected):
        raise AssertionError(f'{label}: {actual!r} != {expected!r}')

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from scipy import stats

def wb_public(name):
    if name.startswith("Q('") and name.endswith("')"):

    return name

def wb_model(fit, names=None, df=None, distribution=None, link="identity"):
    names = names or list(fit.model.exog_names)
    beta = np.asarray(fit.params)

wb_read <- function(name, digest, fmt, options=list()) {
  path <- file.path(base, name)
  hash <- system2("shasum", c("-a", "256", shQuote(path)), stdout=TRUE)
  if (length(hash) != 1L || substr(hash,1,64) != digest) stop(paste("SHA256 mismatch:", name))
  switch(fmt,
    csv=do.call(read.csv, c(list(file=path, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, blank.lines.skip=FALSE, na.strings=c("", "NA")), options)),
    dta=haven::read_dta(path), sav=haven::read_sav(path), xlsx=openxlsx::read.xlsx(path, sheet=if(is.null(options$sheet)) 1 else options$sheet, check.names=FALSE, skipEmptyRows=FALSE, skipEmptyCols=FALSE),
    parquet=as.data.frame(arrow::read_parquet(path)), stop("Unsupported source format"))
}
wb_check <- function(actual, expected, absolute, relative, label) {
  if (length(actual)!=1 || !is.finite(actual) || abs(actual-expected)>absolute+relative*abs(expected))

wb_model <- function(fit, covariance=vcov(fit), df=NULL, distribution="z", aliases=NULL, likelihood=TRUE) {
  beta <- coef(fit)
  names <- names(beta)
  if (!is.null(aliases)) names <- vapply(names, function(n) if (n %in% names(aliases)) aliases[[n]] else n, character(1))
  names <- gsub("`", "", names, fixed=TRUE)
  names[names=="(Intercept)"] <- "Intercept"
  names(beta) <- names
  se <- sqrt(diag(covariance)); names(se) <- names
  statistic <- beta/se
  p <- if (distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(statistic),df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(statistic))
  list(beta=beta,se=se,statistic=statistic,p=p,covariance=covariance,names=names,df=df,

}

wb_read <- function(name, digest, fmt, options=list()) {
  path <- file.path(base, name)
  hash <- system2("shasum", c("-a", "256", shQuote(path)), stdout=TRUE)
  if (length(hash) != 1L || substr(hash,1,64) != digest) stop(paste("SHA256 mismatch:", name))
  switch(fmt,
    csv=do.call(read.csv, c(list(file=path, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, blank.lines.skip=FALSE, na.strings=c("", "NA")), options)),
    dta=haven::read_dta(path), sav=haven::read_sav(path), xlsx=openxlsx::read.xlsx(path, sheet=if(is.null(options$sheet)) 1 else options$sheet, check.names=FALSE, skipEmptyRows=FALSE, skipEmptyCols=FALSE),
    parquet=as.data.frame(arrow::read_parquet(path)), stop("Unsupported source format"))
}
wb_check <- function(actual, expected, absolute, relative, label) {
  if (length(actual)!=1 || !is.finite(actual) || abs(actual-expected)>absolute+relative*abs(expected))
    stop(paste(label, actual, "!=", expected))
}

wb_model <- function(fit, covariance=vcov(fit), df=NULL, distribution="z", aliases=NULL, likelihood=TRUE) {
  beta <- coef(fit)
  names <- names(beta)
  if (!is.null(aliases)) names <- vapply(names, function(n) if (n %in% names(aliases)) aliases[[n]] else n, character(1))
  names <- gsub("`", "", names, fixed=TRUE)
  names[names=="(Intercept)"] <- "Intercept"
  names(beta) <- names
  se <- sqrt(diag(covariance)); names(se) <- names
  statistic <- beta/se
  p <- if (distribution=="t") 2*pt(-abs(statistic),df) else 2*pnorm(-abs(statistic))
  list(beta=beta,se=se,statistic=statistic,p=p,covariance=covariance,names=names,df=df,

}

    path = base / name
